metadata.title: Li'an University Town Carpool
metadata.description: Publish and join carpool trips around Li'an University Town.

home.title: Share the ride, split the cost
home.subtitle: Find classmates heading the same way or publish your own trip. Prices are per trip — the more riders, the less each person pays.

list.subtitle: Every trip published by Li'an University Town students, updated in real time.

publish.title: Publish a Carpool Trip
publish.subtitle: Fill in your trip details. Fields marked * are required. Enter the TOTAL trip price — riders split it evenly by the final headcount.

publish.needLogin: Please log in before publishing a trip.
